description: Waterschappen; begroting, opbrengst heffingen 2009-2017 is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by CBS OpenData. Deze tabel bevat gegevens over de opbrengst van de waterschapsheffingen. Waterschappen leggen deze heffingen op om hun werkzaamheden te bekostigen. De belangrijkste taken zijn waterkering (het tegengaan van overstromingen), waterbeheersing (de zorg voor het juiste waterpeil voor landbouw, natuur, bewoners) en de zorg voor de waterkwaliteit. Sommige waterschappen beheren ook wegen en vaarwegen. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher CBS OpenData. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/ATOM, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON. The portal shows 2025-12-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
